reason: The seven printed answer labels in questions 10–16 use the integral omega-with-Te ligature (U+047E CAPITAL LETTER OT). Compare the pinned native IV/68 p.16, especially enlarged x195–550, y185–450: top bar and descending strokes distinguish the ligature from plain omega and a separate wavy titlo. Full-page inspection corroborates the seven repeated labels. Replace only the initial code point; preserve the already accepted separate name correction and every other character. Other similar glyphs outside these seven labels are not adjudicated here.
